madeFor: The battle scene's digits: the amount beside a drop's icon (Issue-344). The scene draws the glyphs it asks for as sprites at its own scale, never as a font the browser scales.

pixellab.name: heat scene digits 02
pixellab.tags: A font takes no tags; it is found in the gallery by its name.

parameters.description: clean NES-era retro pixel font, thin one pixel strokes, clear open digits, for numbers in a game scene

atlas.note: One cell of glyphPx by glyphPx for each character, row by row in this order, which is the service's own; black on transparent, one bit. There is no space glyph.

notCommitted: The service's TrueType file of the same font, /mcp/font/<jobId>/download_ttf: the scene draws sprites cut from the atlas, and no page loads a font file.

replaced.name: heat scene digits 01

parameters.description: chunky NES-era retro pixel font, cream white letters with a black outline, few colors, for numbers in a game scene

replaced.why: At 8 px the Bold weight's two-pixel strokes closed the digits' counters: its 0 did not read as a zero, and its 8 and 9 read alike. The description's colours and outline were not drawn; an atlas is one bit whatever is asked.

chosenBy: The owner, 2026-11-23, on the dev server, where the digits were seen beside a drop's icon in a battle; the agent had put the second roll forward over the first after reading every digit enlarged on the meadow's green (Issue-344).
verified: atlas.png is byte-identical to a second download from /mcp/font/<jobId>/download, 2026-11-23.
